Containers.Name: ShipLog
Containers.Overview:
Read the changelog before you set sail.
ShipLog adds a Changelog chip to every container in Unraid's Docker tab. Its window shows what changes between your running image and the newest: the release notes, a risk badge (patch, minor, major, or critical for a breaking change) and the real version jump (e.g. 1.7 -> 1.8). A second chip counts the known critical and high vulnerabilities of the running image and tells you which of them the update closes. Only package names and versions leave your server for that check.
Updates run through Unraid's own update, by hand, with Update all or on a schedule limited to the level you choose. In a fortress with a backup app, every auto-update waits for a backup and goes back to the old image if the new one fails.
Optional: changelog summaries from a model server on your own network, and messages through Unraid's notifications, a chat or push service, mail or a webhook. In 26 languages.
